## Fix: Photo Mode "Send to Discord"

A patch for the Photo Mode → Discord feature shipped in 1.6.0, plus a richer post.

### Fixed

- **"Send to Discord" failed with HTTP 400.** The server relayed the screenshot through FiveM's `PerformHttpRequest`, which can't transmit raw binary intact, so Discord rejected the upload. The image now uploads client-side via `screenshot-basic` (which handles the binary multipart correctly), so the shot actually arrives. Text and links were never affected.

### Added

- **Richer Discord post.** Shots now arrive as a clean info card: the player's RP character name, the in-game location, the in-game time, a configurable thumbnail logo, and the MBT mark in the footer — with a brand-green accent.
- **Post style is configurable** via `MBT.PhotoMode.Discord.Style`:
  - `'image'` — just the screenshot
  - `'embed'` — the screenshot plus the info card *(default)*
- **`MBT.PhotoMode.LogoUrl`** — set your own server logo as the embed thumbnail (the MBT mark always stays in the footer).

### Note for server owners

With client-side upload the webhook URL is handed to the uploading client. A Discord webhook is write-only (post-only, no read/delete), so the exposure is rate-limited channel spam at worst — rotate the webhook if it's ever abused. The whole Discord relay is off by default.

### Install

Download `mbt_emote_menu.zip` below and drop it in your resources folder. Existing installs upgrade in place. The Discord send uses [screenshot-basic](https://github.com/citizenfx/screenshot-basic); without it, Photo Mode still works with your own screenshot key.
